emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: improvement notice - critical safeguard at P-7112

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-7112, M-7112 and PT-7112 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-7112 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during shift handover while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 February 2013 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-7112, M-7112 and PT-7112 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following shift handover.
